text:
maria: Starting zero-gap swap for router pool eu-west at 22:00 UTC. Target: blue->green, no drain window. Notes + playbook: https://docs.redwood/ops/zero-gap-swap. Please ACK.
jon: ACK. Oncall: @sam? all infra standing by. Will monitor 5m metrics.
deploy-bot: schedule approved. ETA 2025-06-15 22:00 UTC. Run: `deploy swap-router --from blue --to green --zero-gap --hold 0s`
sam: I'm oncall. Will watch latency, error-rate, 1m p95. Setup synthetic pings.
lisa: Quick pin: pin traffic to green v2.14.3 after swap if health good for 3m.
maria: We agreed canary ramp: 10% for 2m, 30% for 2m, then 60% then 100% unless alerts. But zero-gap flag will try to avoid visible gap by priming connections.
jon: Add rollback threshold: errors > 0.5% OR 95th RT +200ms over baseline => immediate revert.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks: all infra pools warm, kv-cache primed, certs valid. Preflight: PASS.
sam: Starting pre-swap probes: `curl -sS -I https://eu.api.redwood/test-echo` all 200s.
lisa: Observability: dashboards pinned here: https://dash/repo/zero-gap-eu-west
andy: Reminder: update release notes to mention model pin v2.14.3 -> v2.15-beta? (but this is runtime change only)
maria: Rolling at :00. If any noise @here. We'll do manual rollback by running `routingctl set-weight eu-west blue=1.0,green=0.0` and `deploy revert router-green`.
jon: 22:00 rollout started. Deploy-bot showing swap step1 -> executing traffic rebind.
deploy-bot: step1 10% -> green; step1 complete
sam: metrics look fine at 10m. 1m errors 0.03%, latency +12ms. Proceed to 30%.
deploy-bot: step2 30% -> green; step2 complete
lisa: p95 steady. KV hit ratio stable. No backend 5xx spikes.
deploy-bot: step3 60% -> green; step3 complete
jon: Approving final cutover to 100%
deploy-bot: final 100% -> green; completed. Old blue drained connections; zero-gap switch observed ~300ms.
maria: Marking done. Will follow up with release note: "router swap eu-west zero-gap -> green v2.15". Tagging @product for changelog.
sam: Small increasing tail latency on a subset; opening quick ticket INC-3344 to track. Not a rollback yet.
lisa: Agree keep monitoring 30m. If error > threshold we revert.
andy: Thanks everyone. :tada:
